sponsorship.title: Fractionalized Player Sponsorship
sponsorship.description: Fans and investors will soon be able to buy "Player Tokens" to fund a player's training and travel — with revenue routed transparently back on-chain.
sponsorship.howItWorksDescription: Sponsors will purchase fractional Player Tokens representing a stake in a player's future earnings. Funds raised go directly toward training, travel, and development costs, while a share of the player's future on-chain revenue is routed back to token holders — all enforced by Soroban smart contracts.
sponsorship.notice: This page is a placeholder. No tokens can be purchased yet and no blockchain interaction is available here.
